metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for CMS physics analysis: CMSSW, grid tools, FNAL LPC, ML in CMS, and the Scikit-HEP stack.

plugins.name: af-cern-lxplus
plugins.description: Skills for CMS work on CERN lxplus: driving lxplus over ssh, HTCondor batch (lxbatch, CPU and GPU, EosSubmit), EOS and xrootd storage, and CRAB grid submission.

plugins.name: af-fnal-lpc
plugins.description: Skills for the CMS LPC analysis facility at Fermilab (cmslpc): HTCondor batch jobs on the LPC pool with inputs and outputs over XRootD/EOS, plus field notes for large productions on the LPC pool and CMS Connect.

plugins.name: background-est
plugins.description: Data-driven background estimation for CMS analyses: ABCD with closure tests and a likelihood version, and Rhalphabet pass/fail transfer-factor fits for jet-substructure searches.

plugins.name: cms
plugins.description: Core CMS analysis plugin: CMSSW releases and architectures, OS containers, EDM modules, cmsRun configuration, EDM file inspection, and the Scikit-HEP stack on NanoAOD (Awkward Array, vector, hist), plus analysis specifications.

plugins.name: hep-python-tools
plugins.description: Experiment-neutral Python developer tooling for HEP work, with cmslpc notes: PEP 723 standalone scripts run by uv, and Typer command-line tools wired into pyproject.toml.
